_comment: Hearthbound override of Farmer's Delight patch_wild_tomatoes. Stock rarity_filter chance was 100 (1 patch attempt per 100 chunks) — far too sparse next to Croptopia, which places 15-30 crops in EVERY chunk. Lowered to 10. NOTE: the chance values in config/farmersdelight-common.toml are DEAD in the refabricated port — no class reads Configuration.CHANCE_WILD_*; worldgen comes only from these placed_feature JSONs.
